audit.independent_solution: Triangle BPF gives BPF=180−50−60=70. Triangle APD gives APD=180−50−45=85, so CPB=85 by vertical angles. On straight EPF, EPC=180−85−70=25. Triangle CEP is right atE, so x=180−90−25=65 degrees.
